text: Question: A client has a total serum calcium level of 7.6mg/dL. Which clinical manifestations should the nurse expect to note on assessment of the client? Select all that apply.
E. Positive Trousseau and Chvostek sign.
F. Prolonged ST interval and QT interval on EKG.
Correct answers: B. Muscle twitching.; D. Hyperactive deep tendon reflexes.; E. Positive Trousseau and Chvostek sign.; F. Prolonged ST interval and QT interval on EKG.
notes: • “Hyperactive deep tendon reflexes” – A sign of hypocalcemia.
• “Positive Trousseau and Chvostek sign” – A sign of hypocalcemia.
• “Prolonged ST interval and QT interval on EKG” – A sign of hypocalcemia.
• “Hypoactive bowel sounds” – Bowel sounds would be hyperactive.
